environment.description: Same Quarkus 3.2 function on EKS 1.28 in namespace 'prod-graphql'. A Cilium-managed NetworkPolicy with L3/L4 egress rules is applied at the namespace level. The policy spec uses a combination of 'matchLabels' on the pod selector (app: graphql-handler) and a 'cidrGroupRef' deny list. Egress is allowed only to the PostgreSQL service ClusterIP (port 5432) and CoreDNS (port 53 UDP/TCP on kube-system). The policy includes an explicit egress deny entry for CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports via a CiliumNetworkPolicy 'egressDeny' field. Additionally, a secondary standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy object with 'spec.egress' limited to the DB service endpoint exists as a fallback. The pod's node has iptables FORWARD chain rules inserted by the Cilium agent that enforce the L3 deny before any DNAT for the metadata IP occurs.
